# Marigold Secondary School

> Marigold Secondary School is a school in Behror, Rajasthan, India. The school website provides information about academics, admissions, fees, scholarships, school history and contact details.

## School facts

- Name: Marigold Secondary School
- Location: Near Bypass Chowk, Hamindpur Road, Behror, Rajasthan 301701, India
- Education levels: Pre-Nursery to Grade 10
- Established: 2000
- Phone: +91-9414638988
- Email: marigoldvijay@gmail.com
- Official website: https://marigoldschoolbehror.com/
